intro.p1: Most mailbox projects in Vista start when property managers or HOA boards are dealing with aging equipment that has passed its service life, repeated vandalism on older non-secure mailboxes, or USPS notices about non-compliant installations. Vista's mix of planned 1980s and 1990s subdivisions, older apartment stock along Eucalyptus and Escondido avenues, and light industrial parks off Santa Fe Avenue creates a range of property types — each with different mailbox needs. Postal Systems designs and installs code-compliant mailbox systems with USPS coordination, ADA-conscious layouts, inspection sign-off, and clear communication for residents and management.
intro.p2: Instead of managing multiple contractors for pad work, equipment, and USPS coordination, Vista property teams work with one USPS-approved contractor that handles the full scope from site visit through key handover. We document every step so boards and managers have a clear record of what was installed, where, and when.

faqs.question: Do Vista property owners need USPS approval before replacing or relocating mailboxes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Any change to mailbox type, quantity, or location at a Vista property requires USPS review and approval. Postal Systems coordinates directly with USPS on Vista projects so layouts, pads, and equipment meet current DMM 508 standards before installation begins.

faqs.question: Can you match existing Vista HOA mailbox equipment when replacing units in just one section?
faqs.answer: In many cases we can match the manufacturer and finish of existing CBU or 4C equipment at Vista HOA properties, though exact matches depend on what USPS-approved models are currently available. We review photos from your Vista property and provide options before ordering equipment.

faqs.question: Do you handle ADA-compliant mailbox upgrades at Vista apartment and HOA properties?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our Vista mailbox layouts include ADA reach range, approach clearance, and pad slope considerations from the start. When ADA corrections are the primary driver, we document before-and-after conditions so Vista boards and managers have a clear record of improvements made.
